# Flow 4.2: Quota settings screen

Feature: `agent/4-quota/2-quota-settings.md` · PR: https://example.invalid/notifications/pull/221
Before pinned at `c4e0f119` · After pinned at `9b2d5af0`

## Before

Settings has a Notifications section with per-channel opt-in toggles from item 2 and no quota
detail anywhere. The banner's Manage affordance points at this section and stops there.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["QuotaBanner.tsx · QuotaBanner<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/c4e0f119/apps/dashboard/components/QuotaBanner.tsx#L40-L74'>L40-74</a>"]
  B["notifications.tsx · NotificationSettings<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/c4e0f119/apps/dashboard/routes/settings/notifications.tsx#L1-L88'>L1-88</a>"]
  A -->|"Manage link to /settings/notifications"| B
```

## After

A new child route owns the quota detail and its own per-channel query. The banner's Manage link
now lands on it, and the opt-in screen is untouched.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["QuotaBanner.tsx · QuotaBanner<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/9b2d5af0/apps/dashboard/components/QuotaBanner.tsx#L40-L78'>L40-78</a>"]
  B["notifications.tsx · NotificationSettings<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/9b2d5af0/apps/dashboard/routes/settings/notifications.tsx#L1-L92'>L1-92</a>"]
  G["quota.tsx · QuotaSettingsScreen<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/9b2d5af0/apps/dashboard/routes/settings/notifications/quota.tsx#L1-L140'>L1-140</a>"]
  H["useQuotaBreakdown.ts · useQuotaBreakdown<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/9b2d5af0/apps/dashboard/lib/useQuotaBreakdown.ts#L1-L64'>L1-64</a>"]
  I["route.ts · GET /api/quota/breakdown<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/9b2d5af0/apps/api/routes/quota/breakdown/route.ts#L1-L38'>L1-38</a>"]
  C["notification_quota + notification_sends (tables)<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/9b2d5af0/supabase/migrations/0039_notification_quota.sql#L1-L22'>L1-22</a>"]
  A -->|"Manage link to /settings/notifications/quota"| G
  B -->|"child route"| G
  G -->|"usage, reset date, rows per channel"| H
  H -->|"GET on mount"| I
  I -->|"period totals grouped by channel"| C
```

## What changed

- `QuotaBanner`: the Manage link target moves from the section to the new child route.
- `QuotaSettingsScreen`: new screen, owns loading, error and empty states.
- `GET /api/quota/breakdown`: new route, the only per-channel aggregation in the dashboard.
